thought: Hard constraints are currently clean, but soft penalties are dominated by consecutive_cost and non_working_days_cost, with additional pressure from optimal_coverage_cost and weekend overages. Recent block_swap attempts frequently introduced illegal_succession, and block_reassign produced no candidates, so we should try a safer, more local neighborhood that can still reshape work/off patterns without triggering forbidden successions.

strategy.reason: Single-day reassignments can relieve specific nurses' consecutive-work / consecutive-off violations (and indirectly weekend overages) while being less prone than block swaps to create illegal successions; it also helps redistribute workload away from the most problematic nurses without changing total coverage.
strategy.avoid: Avoid block_swap patterns that previously caused illegal_succession spikes and avoid coverage_fill since adding assignments can worsen consecutive patterns and weekend/max-total pressure.
